messages.subject: A few problems
parts:
Hi Guangchuang,

I have a few issues and I cannot find the way how to solve them.
 
I have a tree and I have associated data to it with a dot plot and a stacked bar chart.
So, the figure consist of 3 panels.
I have used the functions facet_plot and geom_facet.

What I would like to do:

- rid off the panel titles completely 
(I want the gray rectangles at the top to disappear) 

- change the relative widths of the columns without rewrite the modifications I made to the figure 
(if I use facet_widths all the modifications I made, like colors, name labels, etc., disappear)

- change manually each scale for each panel independently to each other 
(I changed the scale in the tree using the code
revts(tree) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-300,0,100), labels = abs(seq(-300,0,100)))
and this changed all the other scales as well)

Can you help me please?

Thank you

Regards,

Francesco
